items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 177:1
items.html: From the aspect of the Mochin fixed in Atzilut, AA stands in the place of ZA, and AVI in the place of the Nukva: for AA clothes the HGT of Atik, which are found in the place of the HGT of Nekudim, which are ZA; and AVI clothe from the Peh of AA and downward, which is from the Chazeh [chest] of Nekudim and downward, where is the aspect of the place of the Nukva of ZA. And when the clarifications of ZA are completed, he will then return to the GAR of AA, which is his true place. And likewise, when the clarifications of the Nukva are finished, she will return to the GAR of AVI, where her true place is, as above. And even before the completion of the corrections, on Shabbatot, ZA ascends to the place of AA and the Nukva to AVI. However, besides this not being permanent, the BYA also remains an empty and void place, empty of all light. And at the completion of the correction this will be permanent, and the feet of Atzilut will expand to BYA. (Item 82).
